name: Wanbangde Pharmaceutical Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wanbangde Pharmaceutical Holding Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of traditional Chinese medicine, chemical raw materials, and chemical preparations in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments, the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Business and the Medical Device Business. It offers drugs products used to treat cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases; and nervous, respiratory, mental, and digestive system diseases.
